lessons.title: 4. Enterprise Application Architecture
lessons.description: Checkpoint: export interface ApiResponse<T> { data: T; status: number; } and implement the generic function wrapData<T>(data: T): ApiResponse<T> returning { data, status: 200 }. Tests wrap both a number and an object and check status plus data for each.

tests.name: test_api_response_wrap

learning_objectives: Combine interfaces and generics in API types
Write generic functions with type parameters
Apply TypeScript foundations under checkpoint conditions

source.name: TypeScript Handbook — Generics — working with generic classes and functions

lessons.title: 7. Readonly Fields in Classes
lessons.description: Class fields may be prefixed with the readonly modifier, which prevents assignments to the field outside of the constructor. Export a class Server with `readonly port: number` initialized in the constructor and a method portAddress(): string returning `http://localhost:${this.port}`. Tests construct Server(8080) and check both the field and the address.
learning_objectives: Mark class fields readonly and initialize them in the constructor
Expose computed accessors as class methods
Use template literals inside class methods

source.name: TypeScript Handbook — Classes — readonly modifier: 'prevents assignments to the field outside of the constructor'

tests.name: test_readonly_server
